A closer look at us

What matters
to us.

The people behind Čistá řešení+

We are a small family-run sales, design and installation company based in Tábor. We work in the environmental sector, with a focus on water management structures for municipal water management. Our team includes experienced designers, sales representatives, installation technicians, plumbers and electricians. That is why we can deliver water management projects from A to Z.

The purpose of our work+

Our main mission is to offer quality products and services that improve the state of the environment. We strive to design the best possible solutions for our clients for using rainwater and disposing of wastewater efficiently. Whether the project is a family house, a cabin or a cottage, after an initial consultation we can always propose a suitable tailored solution, from design documentation to complete installation.

Who we work for+

Our clients are property developers, construction and installation companies, as well as end customers. We pride ourselves on a customer-focused approach and on open and fair communication.

The technologies we specialise in+

Among other things, we are an authorised dealer of ENVI-PUR and ASIO domestic wastewater treatment plants, for which, besides sales, we provide professional installation, servicing and advice.
